USDJPY also leads all four on every held-out axis -- CPCV mean OOS Sharpe 0.1629 (0.1405/0.1153/0.1573), lockbox 0.1755 (0.1566/0.1240/0.1602), deflated Sharpe 1.0000 (0.9979/0.9522/0.9999) -- so the max-of-four selection is not what produced its lead.
why_not_the_raw_ranking: THE HONEST RANKING DIFFERS FROM THE RAW ONE AND THIS ROW FOLLOWS THE HONEST ONE. CADJPY was SECOND on raw shadow mean R (+0.4103R) and is LAST of the four on growth: its expectancy falls 0.1631 -> 0.0624 under 3x costs, a 62% haircut against USDJPY's 48%, making it the most cost-fragile of the four at exactly the moment the cost model is least trustworthy. GBPJPY's quoted +0.1624R is contradicted by the desk's own shadow_state.json, which records GBPJPY.asia as n=1, exp_r=-0.0577 after its clock was reset on 2026-09-15; the +0.1624 reads 13 stale phase='forward' tags the state file no longer honours. why_this_rr: rr=2.5, wait_bars=12 -- the growth maximum of the three certified USDJPY parameter sets: E[log W] 0.000926/trade against 0.000876 for rr=2.0 and 0.000701 for rr=1.5, on the SHALLOWEST max drawdown of the three (-12.4R vs -13.3R and -12.3R), so log-wealth prefers it on both terms it cares about. The same cell is what E8 independently selects. It is written under an explicit name (rr25_wb12) rather than the promoter's usual abbreviation, because that scheme strips 'rr=' and the leading digit and renders BOTH rr=1.5 and rr=2.5 as '_5_wb_12' -- which is why no rr=2.5 row existed for any symbol here, gold included, and why gold's own best cell by growth (rr=2.5, 0.002395 against the 0.002129 of the rr=2.0 it runs) is off its live book for a naming reason nobody judged. Fixing the scheme itself needs research/promoter.py, which is sealed.

why_not_all_four: EURJPY against GBPJPY measures +0.891 and the pairwise block runs +0.81 to +0.89, so libs/validation/effective_sample.cross_dependence_deflator(4, 0.891) = 0.273 -- the four crosses are about 1.1 independent bets, not four. EFFECTIVE_BREADTH.json puts all four in one cluster (session_liquidity). Gold against the block is -0.117 (the mean of four rhos spanning -0.39 to +0.08, n=12-14, not distinguishable from zero), so gold plus ONE cross is diversification and gold plus four is one bet bought four times.
